why_no_new_terms: An expository synthesis of two readings of the architecture. Its terms are of two kinds and neither is a term of the novel's world: the vocabulary of the writing engine it analyses (Story Flip, the Collapse Susceptibility Index, the Narrative Context Protocol, the Drama-Engine and the JANUS-Framework, System 1 and System 2, the Context Object) and borrowed physics, psychology and logic (Landauer, Maxwell's demon, Orch-OR, autopoiesis, FDE, dialetheism). Its world's terms are readings on pages that exist. The 144 candidates the lookup found no page for stay candidates; whether the engine's vocabulary earns pages is a question about the wiki's scope and is left to the author (`NOW.md`).
